description: Source file implementing message storage, control management, and metadata serialization for the Thunder project.

classes.name: Controls
classes.description: Manages announced controls, their serialization, and storage association within the Thunder namespace.

methods.name: Controls::Announce
methods.description: Adds a control to the list and enables it if storage is set.

methods.name: Controls::Revoke
methods.description: Removes a control from the list.

methods.name: Controls::Iterate
methods.description: Iterates over all controls, applying a handler.

methods.name: Controls::Set
methods.description: Associates a storage object with the controls.

methods.name: Metadata::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes metadata type, category, and module into a buffer.

methods.name: Metadata::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes metadata from a buffer into type, category, and module.

methods.name: MessageInfo::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes message info including timestamp into a buffer.

methods.name: MessageInfo::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes message info including timestamp from a buffer.

methods.name: MessageInfo::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of message info with timestamp, module, and category.

methods.name: IStore::Tracing::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes tracing information including class name, file name, and line number.

methods.name: IStore::Tracing::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes tracing information.

methods.name: IStore::Tracing::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of tracing info.

methods.name: IStore::WarningReporting::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes warning reporting info including callsign.

methods.name: IStore::WarningReporting::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes warning reporting info.

methods.name: IStore::WarningReporting::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of warning reporting info.

methods.name: IStore::Assert::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes assert info including process ID, name, file, line, and callstack.

methods.name: IStore::Assert::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes assert info.

methods.name: IStore::Assert::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of assert info.

methods.name: IControl::Announce
methods.description: Announces a control to the global control list.

methods.name: IControl::Revoke
methods.description: Revokes a control from the global control list.

methods.name: IControl::Iterate
methods.description: Iterates over all controls with a handler.

methods.name: IStore::Set
methods.description: Sets the global storage object.
